text:
zoe: short thread  prototyping a split-button pattern for row actions (primary + caret menu). want to tighten horizontal gap and decide where to anchor toasts so they don't cover the overflow menu. need quick signoff.

kevin: curious: is this a new component or variant of existing `split-button`? any token changes?

zoe: variant of existing. token proposal: intra-button gap `--space-1` (4px) between primary and caret, but keep `--space-2` (8px) between split-button and neighboring controls. overall action-row gap switches to `--space-2`.

anika: 4px feels tight — will the caret hit target be large enough? caret area needs at least 24x24 tap zone, primary stays min-width 88px and 44px height.

zoe: yes caret will be an explicit 32x32 hit target `button--caret { width:32px; height:32px; }` primary `min-width:88px; height:44px;`. CSS preview: ```css
.split { display:inline-flex; gap: var(--space-1); }
.split .primary { padding: 0 var(--space-2); min-width:88px; height:44px; }
.split .caret { width:32px; height:32px; }
```

pete: ok on visual density. a11y: ensure the caret button has an `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded` toggled. also keyboard nav: arrow keys should move between primary and caret, and caret Enter/Space opens menu.

anika: about DOM order: keep primary first then caret. when we collapse to stacked (mobile) primary should appear above caret visually and in DOM. don't reorder via CSS `order`.

kevin: what about split-button in table rows where there's also an overflow (kebab) control? will proximity confuse users?

zoe: plan: if there's both split and kebab, we group split + kebab with `gap: var(--space-2)` and add a subtle separator between split button halves and kebab when space is tight. separator uses token `--divider-weak`.

a11y-ping: accessibility checklist: caret button labelled `More actions` with `aria-label` that includes context (e.g., "More actions for row 3"). when menu opens, focus should move into menu and close returns focus to caret. voiceover/NVDA tests required.

pete: toasts: current bottom-right anchor overlaps kebab menus in the right rail. propose new behavior: toast anchor follows these rules: desktop => top-right anchored to header (offset `--space-4`), two-column layouts => top-center, mobile => bottom-center full width. newest on top, max 3.

anika: top-right for desktop sounds good for discoverability. ensure toast container avoids the safe area and does not block dropdowns. use `pointer-events:none` on container, `pointer-events:auto` on toasts. also ensure z-index is below modal overlays.

kevin: how do toasts behave when a menu is open? we shouldn't push the menu or steal focus. toasts should stack above content but not capture focus.

a11y-ping: make sure toasts don't cause screen reader surprise: use `aria-live="polite"` for neutral/info messages and `role="alert"` for errors. only the most recent toast should be announced. add debounce: if two toasts appear within 400ms, only announce newest.

zoe: implementation note: add `--toast-gap: var(--space-2)` and `--toast-anchor-offset: var(--space-4)`. animation: fade+translateY, but honor `prefers-reduced-motion`. sample CSS: ```css
.toast-container--top-right { position:fixed; top:var(--toast-anchor-offset); right:var(--toast-anchor-offset); pointer-events:none; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:var(--toast-gap); }
.toast { pointer-events:auto; transform: translateY(-6px); transition: opacity .18s, transform .18s; }
@media (max-width:480px) { .toast-container--mobile { left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); bottom: var(--space-3); width: calc(100% - var(--space-4)); } }
```

pete: copy nit: use `Dismiss` for toast action, not `Close`. also prefer sentence case for split-button labels.

anika: testing: i'll run keyboard + screen reader flows for split-button and toast combinations. cases: open kebab, open split menu, trigger toast, press Esc to dismiss toast, verify focus stays in menu, and Esc closes menu then returns focus.

zoe: i'll add those tests to the a11y board and open a token PR to adopt `--space-1` for split internals and `--space-2` for action-row gaps. will include examples: table row with split+kebab, card action row, mobile stacked.

deploy-bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview.redwood/ui/split-button-1977771234 (visual diffs + token deltas).

kevin: pm ok. if a11y checks pass and devs confirm caret hit target, we can freeze for the sprint.
